name: Daqin Railway Co., Ltd.
summary: Daqin Railway Co., Ltd. provides railway freight and passenger transport services in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It transports coal, coke, steel, and ore, as well as containers and scattered bulk goods. The company also provides railway passenger and freight transportation, railway freight loading and unloading warehousing, etc. services. In addition, it offers services to other domestic railway transportation enterprises, including locomotive traction, freight car use, track use, and freight car repair, etc. Daqin Railway Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Taiyuan, the People's Republic of China.
